testDefinitions.notes: TLC silica gel F254 plate; test solution (~17 000 IU vitamin A digested with bromelains in 2-propanol and water) vs 10 mg/mL retinol esters CRS in 2-propanol with 1 g/L BHT; mobile phase ether : cyclohexane (20:80 V/V); develop 15 cm, dry in air, examine under UV 254 nm. Principal spot corresponds to reference solution (BP 2024; source: Vitamin A Synrhetic__STM Synthetic Retinol Acetate (Powder Form).txt:30).

sources.source: Vitamin A Synrhetic__STM Synthetic Retinol Acetate (Powder Form).txt:30

testDefinitions.notes: Make a slurry of the powder in an equal-volume mixture of isopropyl alcohol and methylene dichloride, pour onto a glass tile and dry; film formed (source: Opadry green__STM Opadry Green.txt:31).

Empty crucible previously ignited at 800 °C (W1); weigh ~1.0 g sample (W2); ignite in muffle at 800 ± 50 °C for 2 h; cool in desiccator; weigh crucible with residue (W4). Residue W3 = W4 - W1; total ash % = (W4 - W1) / W2 x 100 (formula as written in STM: total ash = W2 - W3 where W3 = W4 - W1; source: Opadry green__STM Opadry Green.txt:32).

Dissolve ~20 mg in 10 mL water, add 1 mL dilute acetic acid and 1.6 mL 1 M NaOH, heat 30 min in water bath, cool, add 5 mL dilute NaOH, 10 mL potassium ferricyanide solution and 10 mL butanol, shake 2 min. Upper layer shows intense light-blue fluorescence (UV 365 nm). Negative control with 0.9 mL 1 M NaOH and 0.1 g anhydrous sodium sulfite shows practically no fluorescence (BP 2024; source: Thiamine Hydrochloride__STM-003 Thiamine Hydrochloride.txt:30).

Dissolve 40 mg sample in 2 mL water, add 2 mL sulfuric acid, cool, superimpose 2 mL ferrous sulfate TS; no brown ring produced at junction of two layers (USP 2024; source: Thiamine Hydrochloride__STM-003 Thiamine Hydrochloride.txt:34).

100 mg/mL solution in water, filtered through syringe filter or fine sintered-glass funnel; absorbance against water blank in 1-cm cell at 400 nm; limit NMT 0.025 (USP 2024 <857>; source: Thiamine Hydrochloride__STM-003 Thiamine Hydrochloride.txt:35).

testDefinitions.displayName: Assay of thiamine hydrochloride (BP, non-aqueous potentiometric titration)
testDefinitions.titrationEquivalencyFactorDerivation: 16.86 mg C12H18Cl2N4OS per mL of 0.1 M HClO4 / 0.1 = 168.6 mg/mmol
testDefinitions.notes: Dissolve 0.110 g sample in 5 mL anhydrous formic acid, add 50 mL acetic anhydride, titrate within 2 min with 0.1 M perchloric acid VS potentiometrically; blank titration. Eq.wt = 16.86 mg/mL of 0.1 M titrant (F = 168.6 mg/mmol). Anhydrous substance basis (BP 2024; source: Thiamine Hydrochloride__STM-003 Thiamine Hydrochloride.txt:39).

testDefinitions.displayName: Assay of thiamine hydrochloride (USP, HPLC internal standard)
testDefinitions.notes: USP assay: 400 µg/mL thiamine HCl + 0.2% methyl benzoate internal standard in mobile phase (Solution A 0.005 M sodium 1-octanesulfonate in 1% acetic acid : Solution B methanol:acetonitrile 3:2, 60:40); column 4.0-mm x 30-cm L1, 1 mL/min, UV 254 nm. Limit 98.0%-102.0% on anhydrous basis (USP 2024; source: Thiamine Hydrochloride__STM-003 Thiamine Hydrochloride.txt:38).
